comments.content: These counters only observe transitions made during this invocation. If the status changes between checks—most notably when `SYSTEM RESTART DISK` clears `broken`—the next run snapshots the already-cleared value, so `BrokenDisks` is never decremented and remains stale. Track the last status reported to CurrentMetrics (and reconcile it on every run and shutdown), or update the metric in every external status-changing path.
